business_model.claim: Adamas Trust is an internally managed mortgage REIT. It invests mainly in residential mortgage assets (Agency RMBS, residential loans including business purpose loans, non-Agency RMBS) and also some multi-family assets. It also originates business purpose loans through its subsidiary Constructive.
quotes: Through our wholly-owned subsidiary, Constructive, we also originate business purpose loans for residential real estate investors.

We derive the substantial portion of our revenues and income from our investment portfolio.

business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K description; figures are from the 10-Q income statement
business_model.claim: The investment portfolio earns interest income, net income (loss) from real estate and other income. Interest income is the main line. It was 527,692 (table in thousands) for the nine months ended Sep. 30, 2026. Interest expense was 380,275 (table in thousands), leaving net interest income of 147,417 (table in thousands).
quotes: Our investment portfolio, which includes primarily mortgage-related residential assets, generates revenues, including interest income, net income (loss) from real estate and other income, for us.

Yield on average interest earning assets was 5.95% and average financing cost was (4.55)%, giving a net interest spread of 1.40%. The Agency segment's spread was 1.68% and the single-family credit segment's was 1.55%.

business_model.basis: stated in the balance sheet, release and 10-K; the link between leverage and magnified results is inferred from the risk factors
business_model.claim: Assets are mostly Agency RMBS and residential loans, funded largely with short-term repurchase agreements and securitization debt. business_model.basis: stated in the 10-K, the income statement and the release
business_model.claim: Constructive earns revenue by originating business purpose loans to residential real estate investors and selling them. It also supplies loans to the investment portfolio. Loan origination costs were 4,198 (table in thousands) in the quarter and 13,070 (table in thousands) for nine months. Constructive originated $405.8 million of loans in Q3.
quotes: Constructive represents the mortgage origination business conducted by Constructive, a business purpose loan lender specializing in rental and transitional loans for real estate investors, which generates revenues from the origination and sale of loans.

General and administrative expenses rose to 74,363 (table in thousands) from 47,549 (table in thousands).

business_model.basis: stated in the income statement, the 10-K risk factors and the release
